description: This file defines a React context and hooks for managing directional focus (TV remote style) across focusable components in a React application. It includes a provider component, hooks for registration and focus control, and utility functions for focus navigation, selection, and back actions.

methods.name: useFocusRegistry
methods.description: Custom hook that manages a registry of focusable nodes, allowing registration, focus setting, and navigation between nodes.

methods.name: FocusManagerProvider
methods.description: React component that provides the focus management context to its children.

methods.name: useFocusManager
methods.description: Hook to access focus management API from components within the provider.

methods.name: useFocusable
methods.description: Hook for components to register themselves as focusable elements with directional neighbors and callbacks.
